_comment: Publication gates for sections that are only real once genuine, owner-approved content exists behind them (see docs/owner-inputs-required.md). `published: true` means the page/content block is built and included — indexed and in nav/sitemap for a page-level gate (meta.publishGate), rendered for a content-block gate (<!--NAV:key-->...<!--/NAV:key--> markers, see scripts/build.js). `published: false` means it is omitted entirely from every normal build (preview AND production, local AND the GitHub Pages public deploy) — not just noindexed. A page/block behind a false gate is reviewable only via ALLOW_DRAFT=true, a local-only editorial mode that writes outside site/ and pages-dist/ and the GitHub Pages workflow never sets (see scripts/build.js's top-of-file comment). Flip a flag to true only once its `requiredForPublish` conditions are actually met, and record what was supplied in docs/owner-inputs-required.md.

projects.requiredForPublish: At least three owner-approved, real completed-project case studies (see docs/07-owner-confirmations.md and docs/05-photography-shotlist.md).

products.requiredForPublish: Owner-approved brands/models actually supplied, with source-confirmed specifications and warranty wording (see docs/owner-inputs-required.md).

learningCentre.requiredForPublish: Complete, useful articles with no unanswered-question cards. Currently met: every section is a finished, substantive answer, not a stub.

commercialBatteryAssessment.requiredForPublish: Secure CRM submission is connected and a complete end-to-end lead test has passed.

customerReviews.requiredForPublish: Owner has verified the full review set the embedded HighLevel widget (widget ID 6a98ba1ddb444e2cfc4f0d6f) actually displays — this exact widget is also used by the existing live site, whose indexed output has shown Melbourne-labelled testimonials and duplicated review wording. Until verified, the 'What customers say' section is omitted sitewide, not shown empty or with a placeholder.

teslaMarketing.requiredForPublish: Tesla's own written marketing/publication approval. Owner-confirmed directly in this Claude session (30 Sep 2026) as already granted — see docs/owner-inputs-required.md's Tesla section for the full history, including the real Gmail-thread evidence trail from an earlier pass. This flag is a status record only; no code path in scripts/build.js conditionally removes Tesla content based on it (the owner's explicit instruction was to preserve it, not gate it) — scripts/qa-static-checks.js's existing Tesla checks (approved pages + approved titles only) remain the active safeguard.
